01 · Heat

Heat from every angle

Full spectrum infrared, near, mid and far, from heaters placed 360° around you.

700–25,000nm on every model. Indoor models reach 150°F. Outdoor models reach 170°F.

02 · Red light

Red light, built in

Medical-grade red light therapy comes standard. It is not an add-on.

One panel on models like the Fuji and Everest. Two on the Denali, Matterhorn and El Capitan.

03 · Materials

Real wood. Real metal.

Cabins in Canadian red cedar or Canadian hemlock. The outdoor models wrap a hemlock interior in black space-grade aluminum.

The Fuji is Canadian red cedar inside and out.

04 · Ritual

Your session, your way

Two Bluetooth speakers in every model. Peak Wellness Club is included free, with expert protocols for temperature, duration, timing and breathwork.

Club members also get a streak leaderboard and the Sauna Lounge, a private owner community.

05 · Backed

Backed for seven years

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

Free shipping, always, in a PeakGuard custom wooden crate. In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days.
